𝕏 Money is growing fast

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-11-18T17:16:15+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2123103002181706058; média: 1 kép]
You can now send money internationally with X Money, directly from 𝕏

X Money now supports international bank transfers to 27 countries, with recipients receiving funds in their local currency

Supported countries:

🇦🇺 Australia
🇦🇹 Austria
🇧🇪 Belgium
🇨🇦 Canada
🇨🇾 Cyprus
🇪🇪 Estonia
🇫🇮 Finland
🇫🇷 France
🇩🇪 Germany
🇬🇷 Greece
🇭🇰 Hong Kong
🇮🇳 India
🇮🇪 Ireland
🇮🇹 Italy
🇱🇹 Lithuania
🇱🇺 Luxembourg
🇲🇾 Malaysia
🇲🇽 Mexico
🇳🇱 Netherlands
🇳🇴 Norway
🇵🇭 Philippines
🇵🇹 Portugal
🇸🇬 Singapore
🇸🇮 Slovenia
🇪🇸 Spain
🇸🇪 Sweden
🇬🇧 United Kingdom

And everything happens directly inside 𝕏

Here's how it works:

1. Open the Money tab and select Send Money
2. Tap Send a wire and choose the destination country
3. Enter the recipient's name, address and bank details
4. Enter the amount, review the exchange rate and confirm

Depending on the destination, you'll need an IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, account number or local banking code

And the fees are surprisingly straightforward:

• $1.65 + 0.65% per international transfer
• Same fee across all subscription plans
• No separate currency conversion fee from X Money
• Most transfers arrive within 1–2 business days
• Up to $15,000 per transaction
• Up to $15,000 sent per day
• 30-minute cancellation window

You'll see the converted recipient amount before confirming, although intermediary or receiving banks may charge additional fees

And here's another useful protection

If a transfer is returned because of incorrect bank details, X Money refunds the amount sent, even if exchange rates have changed. The original transfer fee is not refunded

International wires currently support personal bank accounts in these 27 countries, with the feature still in beta for eligible U.S. X Money users

No separate money-transfer app required

Just open 𝕏, choose the recipient, and send money directly to their bank account

Another major step toward making 𝕏 the everything app
